title: Santa-hat bat ornament
subtitle: Traced from your wall photo · 50 mm wingspan · black base with the red hat and white trim on top · hangs from a tiny hole in the pom-pom, shown as it hangs · millimetres
scale_note: Real size: 50 mm wing tip to wing tip (your pick). The photo looks along the wall, so the bat appeared squashed sideways; it's stretched 1.23× to undo that (estimated from the round pom-pom).
notes_title: v6: what changed, what to check
notes: v6: back to a hole through the pom-pom, as small as reliably prints: 1.2 mm (it'll come out about 1 mm), with 1.4 mm of pom-pom around it. It hangs almost wings-level again. Thread it with fishing line, sewing thread, or fine wire; if the hole closes up a little, a needle or pin opens it. Everything else as before: a black 2 mm base with the red and white layered on top (~5 colour swaps).
